_meta.description: ANC departure mix, domestic vs. outbound international, monthly and by year -- the long-haul proxy for the 'percentage of long-haul flights out of Anchorage' question, replacing an earlier OpenFlights-route-count approach. See this module's build_anc_traffic_mix() docstring for the full reasoning, including why the true distance-threshold percentage isn't computable from any publicly downloadable BTS table.
_meta.source: BTS T100 Segment Summary By Origin Airport (data.bts.gov, dataset r495-tyji), filtered to ANC
_meta.definition_note:
KEY DEFINITION, verified against the raw data: 'total_departures' ==
    'domestic_departures' + 'outbound_international' exactly (checked on
    every row). 'inbound_international' (flights arriving at ANC FROM
    abroad, i.e. ANC as destination) is a separate figure BTS reports
    alongside it and is deliberately EXCLUDED here -- it is not a flight
    OUT OF Anchorage, so including it would answer a different question
    ("ANC's total international exposure") under the guise of this one.
